query: Retrieve analytics for a specific report ID, apply updated configurations to a specified machine, and adjust the inventory levels for the material associated with the configuration changes.
code_without:
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.socbench.example"

report_id = "REPORT_ID"
machine_id = "MACHINE_ID"
item_id = "ITEM_ID"

report_response = requests.get(
    f"{BASE_URL}/analytics/{report_id}"
)
report_response.raise_for_status()
report = report_response.json()

configuration = {
    "configuration": {
        "reportId": report_id,
        "data": str(report.get("data", {})),
    }
}

config_response = requests.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/machines/{machine_id}/configurations",
    json=configuration,
)
config_response.raise_for_status()

inventory_response = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/resources/inventory")
inventory_response.raise_for_status()
inventory = inventory_response.json()

item = next((entry for entry in inventory if entry.get("itemId") == item_id), None)
if item is None:
    raise ValueError(f"Inventory item {item_id!r} was not found")

updated_quantity = item["quantity"] - 1

update_response = requests.put(
    f"{BASE_URL}/resources/inventory/{item_id}",
    json={"quantity": updated_quantity},
)
update_response.raise_for_status()

code_without:
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.socbench.example"

product_details = {
    "name": "Newly Designed Personal Care Product",
    "category": "lotion",
    "ingredients": ["ingredient_a", "ingredient_b"],
}

compliance_response = requests.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/regulation-check",
    json={"product_details": product_details},
)
compliance_response.raise_for_status()
compliance_result = compliance_response.json()

sustainability_response = requests.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/sustainability-assessment",
    json={"product_details": product_details},
)
sustainability_response.raise_for_status()
sustainability_result = sustainability_response.json()

report_response = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/reports/compliance")
report_response.raise_for_status()
compliance_report = report_response.json()

status = str(compliance_result.get("compliance_status", "")).strip().lower()
if status not in {"compliant", "complies", "passed", "pass"}:
    raise RuntimeError(
        "The product is not confirmed compliant. "
        "No order-cancellation endpoint is documented, so the associated order cannot be cancelled."
    )

query: Create a new software license for a financial application, set its license type as perpetual, and trigger an alert notifying the team about the configuration. Validate its configuration by running a transformation action to ensure compliance with organizational rules, and upon success, test the integration of the alert notification system to confirm real-time monitoring capabilities for software usage incidents. Delete an outdated transformation rule no longer required for license validation, retrieve the current automated workflows available for handling software-related alerts, and fetch a list of existing transformation and analytical rules for review.
code_with:
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.socbench.example"
session = requests.Session()
session.headers.update({"Content-Type": "application/json"})

license_response = session.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/software/licenses",
    json={
        "application": "financial application",
        "licenseType": "perpetual",
    },
)
license_response.raise_for_status()

alert_response = session.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/alert",
    json={
        "description": "The perpetual software license for the financial application has been configured. Please monitor software usage incidents."
    },
)
alert_response.raise_for_status()

transformation_response = session.post(
    f"{BASE_URL}/data/transform",
    json={
        "ingestionID": license_response.json().get("ingestionID", "license-validation")
    },
)
transformation_response.raise_for_status()

integration_response = session.post(f"{BASE_URL}/integration/test")
integration_response.raise_for_status()

outdated_rule_id = "outdated-license-validation-rule"
delete_rule_response = session.delete(
    f"{BASE_URL}/config/rules/{outdated_rule_id}"
)
delete_rule_response.raise_for_status()

workflows_response = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/settings/workflows")
workflows_response.raise_for_status()

rules_response = session.get(f"{BASE_URL}/config/rules")
rules_response.raise_for_status()
